basis: Recurrent narrowing of a coronary artery defines the disease.
Chronic congestive liver injury and fibrosis after Fontan circulation; the underlying congenital heart disease is separate.
Axonal peripheral neuropathy; persistent foot deformities occur in about 50% and distal amyotrophy in 16/17. Isolated mitral regurgitation does not establish common cardiac involvement.
Inherited retinal degeneration defines retinitis pigmentosa.
Organ-specific hereditary pancreatic cancer susceptibility maps to exocrine pancreas; this does not imply existing cancer. Melanoma is a separate tumour with unspecified frequency.
Dysplastic glandular neoplasm arising in rectal mucosa.
Congenital structural heart disease defines the umbrella; pancreatic hypoplasia and diabetes are optional syndromic features without evidence of >=30% prevalence.
ERBIN-related combined immunodeficiency with hyper-IgE; chronic eczematous dermatitis is a common (>30%) manifestation. Infection risks alone do not establish other organ damage.
Excess pancreatic islet insulin secretion; supplied HPO reports progressive neurologic deterioration in 80-99%, supporting lasting neuroglycopenic injury rather than transient symptoms.
A dysplastic epithelial adenoma arising in the colon.
Inflammation of the eyelids; the umbrella is not uniformly infectious or autoimmune.

Skin fragility and joint disease define dEDS; GI hernia/reflux reported in 80-99%, gingival disease in >=30%; myopia in 3/4 with frequent astigmatism. Vascular complications are not established as common.
Epilepsy beginning during the neonatal period is a neurologic disorder.
Isolated sperm production, morphology and motility defects causing male infertility; no endocrine dysfunction or other covered organ disease is established.
Skeletal and digital abnormalities, deafness and cleft palate define the syndrome; palate is gastrointestinal.
Broad gonadal disease umbrella explicitly includes endocrine disease, hypogonadism and pubertal dysfunction; gonads in their hormonal role map to metabolic_endocrine.
Autoimmune disease whose defining manifestation is cutaneous urticaria.
Inherited coagulation factor deficiency; joint hemorrhage is reported in 30-79% and directly injures joints. Epistaxis alone does not establish lasting airway damage.
Autoimmune systemic sclerosis with lung involvement and defining skin fibrosis; intrinsic esophageal/GI fibrosis and dysmotility affect >50%.
Cerebellar disease and intellectual disability define SCAR20; skeletal deformities occur in >=30%. Sensorineural hearing loss is annotated 30-79%, though another hearing series reports 5/22.
Skin laxity and severe arterial tortuosity/aneurysms define disease; sparse stroke (1/3), emphysema (1/1) and skeletal reports do not reliably establish common lasting damage.
Hypogonadotropic hypogonadism; olfactory bulb aplasia in 4/6 and hyposmia in 5/10 establish common structural olfactory dysfunction. Hearing loss and seizures are minority features.
Cystadenocarcinoma arising in the biliary tree; bile ducts belong to the hepatic axis.
EDC3-related intellectual disability; sensorineural hearing impairment reported in 1/2 patients (~50%), with substantial sampling uncertainty. Iris heterochromia does not establish eye damage.
Drug-induced retinal and macular atrophy with lasting visual loss defines this disease; treatment causation does not exclude its defining primary organ.
